title: Give It A Lance!
body:
This texture pack fully retextures minecraft's Spear weapon type into a Lance!

[Husk holding a Netherite Lance](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/084769feeb5c4afc53690932a7e8e911d36e49b9.png)

i'm not super fond of spears, they're HELLA boring so i decided 'whatever, i'll FIX IT MYSELF' and. here we are!

no you cannot use these textures for anything else, please do not trace them, and if you take inspiration PLEASE just make them unique enough? i've had enough people steal my art </3
